abstract_summary: Selecting synthetic degradations for dense prediction requires an estimate of their training utility, the generalization gain they bring under a finite training budget. Clean and degraded twins share content and labels, suggesting a score based on how much short training reduces the excess error caused by degradatio...

scholarly_quality.concise_summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous, well-controlled experimental setup addressing a genuine confound in synthetic data selection. The mathematical formulation is clear, baselines are fairly adapted under matched budgets, and empirical analyses thoroughly probe underlying mechanisms.

Wepropose thecontrolled
Reducible Degradation Gap(cRDG)forregionsdefinedbydegradationtypeandseverity. Froma
common checkpoint, cRDG runs two budget-matched probes that differ only in one augmentation
slot, which holds either a synthetic degradation or a clean augmentation. The score is the gain on
held-out degraded images relative to the clean-control probe. Clean harm is a separate feasibility
constraint. cRDG reveals a correctable severity band in which training on the degradation yields
high controlled gain under the available budget, and the band moves with the predictor, the
starting checkpoint, and the training budget.Curation of Reducible Bands(CuRB) uses cRDG to
select synthetic data without changing the predictor. On semantic segmentation and salient object
detection,CuRBimproves representative predictors under matched synthetic-data budgets

evidence.excerpt:
Bands(CuRB), a curation framework that adds
degradation-aware selection to existing dense predictors without changing their architectures.
Scores are recomputed for the operating checkpoint and budget. The band only summarizes
the profile. Selection ranks feasible positive-score regions directly and fills a fixed synthetic
budget in rank order, with validity gating before ranking and𝑘-center sampling for the last
partial region.
Our contributions are as follows.
• We formulatebudget-conditioned correctability. Training utility need not track severity, realism,
or difficulty, and the useful severity region migrates with predictor, checkpoint, and probe
budget.
• We proposecRDG, a held-out, budget-matched estimate of the gain from training on a
degradation region relative to an equally long clean-control probe, with clean harm handled
separately.
• We introduceCuRB, a plug-and-play

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Full downstream retraining on established external benchmarks (ACDC, Dark Zurich, WXSOD, CSOD10K) shows consistent gains over uncurated and baseline-curated sets, and region-level cRDG rankings correlate with independently measured per-region retraining utility.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard benchmark metrics on real adverse-condition and SOD test sets (mIoU on ACDC/Dark Zurich, MAE/F-beta/E-measure/S-measure on WXSOD/CSOD10K), plus per-region retraining gains on real targets.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Short K-step treatment and clean-control probe losses on split source data, used to compute cRDG and rank degradation-severity regions for selection.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding the non-monotonic nature of training utility, the shift in correctable bands across models/budgets, and CuRB's performance gains over uncurated twins and baseline valuation metrics are directly supported by benchmark metrics and correlation with ground-truth retraining gains.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluations are comprehensive across semantic segmentation (Cityscapes to ACDC, Dark Zurich) and salient object detection (WXSOD, CSOD10K) under strict budget-matched protocols. The paper isolates the effect of curation against multiple data-selection baselines, tests plug-in compatibility across several generators, verifies compute tradeoffs, and performs informative ablations.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Full downstream retraining evaluated on established external benchmarks (ACDC, Dark Zurich, WXSOD, CSOD10K) demonstrates consistent performance gains over uncurated and baseline-curated sets.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard benchmark test evaluation metrics (mIoU on real adverse conditions like ACDC/Dark Zurich, and MAE/F-beta/E-measure/S-measure on real SOD datasets).
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Short K-step treatment and control probe training losses on split source data using synthetic degradation twins versus weak photometric augmentations.

primary.limitations: The authors transparently document limitations, including reliance on single-run evaluations for final training, residual drift near gate thresholds, reliance on cross-family transfer for completely novel degradation types, and probe budget heuristics.
primary.method_assessment: The method mathematically isolates degradation-specific reducible error from clean forgetting and generic optimization progress using cross-fitted matched control probes. The candidate pool generation, structural DINOv2 validity gating, budget allocation, and clean-harm constraint are well specified.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a rigorous, well-controlled experimental setup addressing a genuine confound in synthetic data selection. The mathematical formulation is clear, baselines are fairly adapted under matched budgets, and empirical analyses thoroughly probe underlying mechanisms.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces the controlled Reducible Degradation Gap (cRDG) and the Curation of Reducible Bands (CuRB) framework, which scores synthetic degradation-severity regions via budget-matched short probes relative to a clean-control stream, curating synthetic data for dense prediction without target-domain exposure.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a rigorous, well-controlled experimental setup addressing a genuine confound in synthetic data selection. The mathematical formulation is clear, baselines are fairly adapted under matched budgets, and empirical analyses thoroughly probe underlying mechanisms.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors transparently document limitations, including reliance on single-run evaluations for final training, residual drift near gate thresholds, reliance on cross-family transfer for completely novel degradation types, and probe budget heuristics.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.

relation_to_agentic_memory.value: Segmentation task adjacent to detection; shares backbones and dense-prediction evaluation

research_relevance.value: Directly relevant to computer-vision research based on screening evidence.
